summary: First Phosphate Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 16, 2026 press release disclosing a Letter of Support from Swiss Export Risk Insurance (SERV) covering approximately USD 212.5 million, equal to 85% of an assumed USD 250 million eligible Swiss export contract value, for Swiss machinery and processing-facility construction at its Bégín-Lamarche igneous phosphate project in Saguenay-Lac-St-Jean, Quebec. SERV would consider up to 95% cover of the financed amount under OECD guidelines, potentially reinsuring non-Swiss content. No securities, ownership, board recommendation, or transaction terms are implicated; this is a project-finance credit-support milestone, not a special situation. Watch export-contract finalization and any associated equity or debt financing.
